title: refactor(ui)!: the renderer runs @objectstack/sdui-parser; delete @object-ui/sdui-parser (#25712 2g PR 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao7EJRrpBukNTDcMt2XiXQX1)_

Part of #25712 (item 3 = 2g, PR 2 of 3: rewrite the importers onto `@objectstack/sdui-parser` and delete `ui/packages/sdui-parser`; Tier H: over 3000 lines, and `skills/**`).
Part of #25677.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing: a `type-mismatch` or `member-type-mismatch` the html-tier compile used to grade `warning` is now an `error`, so a page that carried one now refuses to compile instead of rendering with the value dropped)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:**
  - 按 2g 裁定(6418729849,E+B),ui 里所有对 `@object-ui/sdui-parser` 的引用改为 `@objectstack/sdui-parser`,包括 import、`package.json` 依赖、vite/vitest 别名和 tsconfig 路径。
  - 删除 `ui/packages/sdui-parser`(不发转发版本),并把它移出 changesets 的 fixed 组。
  - `gen-manifest.ts` 移到 `ui/apps/console/scripts/`。PR 1 留下的 5 个测试搬到各自归属的包。
  - ui 里按包数计数的几个门禁同步减一。manifest 记录不再包含这个包。
- **哪些原来能渲染的现在会报错:** 渲染器原来那份解析器只在 enum 旁把类型不符判为 error,其他情况只给 warning。现在统一按保存门的规则判为 error。所以 html 层页面里属性类型写错(例如 `columns='["name","amount"]'`,而 `columns` 声明为数组)会显示编译错误块,不再静默丢掉这个值。保存门本来就拒绝这种页面,所以经保存门保存的页面不受影响。
- **为什么改:** 两份解析器只剩一份,渲染器和保存门跑同一套代码。PR 3(#26221)和 PR 1(#26211)已经合入。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 约 8400 行变更,其中约 7000 行是删除(被删的包和锁文件)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。合入后 npm 上的 `@object-ui/sdui-parser` 停在 18.1,18.2 之后由维护者执行 npm deprecate。
- **需要你确认的一件事:** 两个待发布的 changeset(`25831-object-ui-18-1-to-merge.md`、`26276-ui-package-test-vitest.md`)原本列着 `@object-ui/sdui-parser`。包删掉后,`changeset version` 遇到不存在的包会失败,所以本 PR 删掉了这两行。`check-empty-changeset` 把这种改动当作需要人确认的「主动更正」,会一直是红的,直到你确认。
- **你要做的:** 确认上面两行删除,然后批准(Tier H)。

## 席位核对

(left for the dispatch seat)

## Why

Ruling 6418729849 on #25712 keeps `@objectstack/sdui-parser` as the one parser, deletes `ui/packages/sdui-parser` with no forwarding release, and takes `@object-ui/sdui-parser` out of the fixed group. The maintainer deprecates the npm package after 18.2. PR 3 (#26221, lockstep gate retired) and PR 1 (#26211, one body in `@objectstack/sdui-parser`) are on main. This PR moves the renderer onto that body and deletes the second copy.

## What changes

**Importers (no behaviour of their own).**
- Every `@object-ui/sdui-parser` import, `package.json` dependency key, vite alias (console, console-starter, plugin-editor, plugin-markdown, runner), the `ui/vitest.config.mts` alias and the `ui/tsconfig.json` paths now name `@objectstack/sdui-parser`, which resolves to the root `packages/sdui-parser`.
- No importer uses the deprecated `SchemaNode` / `ValidationResult` aliases.
- Kept on purpose:
  - the `Symbol.for('@object-ui/sdui-parser.html-tier-node')` registry key, which is the cross-instance contract;
  - the MIT "moved in from `@object-ui/sdui-parser`" notices;
  - CHANGELOGs and dated QA notes.

**Deleted:** `ui/packages/sdui-parser` (32 files).

**Moved:**

| From | To |
|---|---|
| `ui/packages/sdui-parser/scripts/gen-manifest.ts` | `ui/apps/console/scripts/gen-manifest.ts` (its only caller is `emit-sdui-manifest.ts`) |
| `…/__tests__/render.test.tsx`, `inline-whitespace.test.tsx`, `injected-component-input-6950.test.ts` | `ui/packages/react/src/__tests__/sdui-*` (they import `../SchemaRenderer`, not `@object-ui/react`, per `check-package-self-import`) |
| `…/__tests__/spec-symbol-batch7.test.ts` | `packages/lint/src/sdui-spec-symbol-batch7.test.ts` |
| `…/__tests__/dashboard-widget-options-census.test.ts` | `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/` (leg 4 no longer counts the ui copy) |

`@object-ui/react` gains `@objectstack/sdui-parser` as a devDependency for the re-homed tests.

**Guards that counted the package:**
- package floors drop by one:
  - `package-files-exist`: owing floor 38→37;
  - `side-effects-declaration-consistency`: 29→28 and `false` 12→11;
  - `check-dist-completeness`: tsc floor 12→11;
  - `QUICK_REFERENCE.md`: 37→36 published packages;
  - `check:lockstep-package-count`: 111→110 in `backward-compatibility.mdx` and `publish-smoke-pack.mjs`.
- `turbo.objectui.json` drops the 10 build inputs that pointed at the deleted package.
- `select-type-check-scope`'s fixture now uses a live file.
- `check-type-check-coverage` drops the deleted scripts directory.
- The cli `workspace-vite` alias list drops the package.
- `ui/.github/labeler.yml` drops its rule.
- `.changeset/config.json` removes it from the fixed group.

**Relative reads re-rooted** to the root parser:
- `designerRegistrationInputs-11434`;
- `body-dialect-children-arm-7181`;
- `component-input-retired-keys-7493`;
- `unconsumed-widget-option-claim-6186`;
- the `ui/README.md` link, which is now a GitHub URL because `check-doc-links` treats `ui/` as its root.

**Severity pin.** `htmlTierColumnSpellings-6598` form 2 (a JSON string where `columns` is declared `array`) moves from "the block's defaults render" to "fails loudly". The page now shows the compile error naming `columns`. The test's invariant, "never the reported state", holds either way.

**Manifest record.** `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` drops `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/sdui-parser.json` ("no longer reached") and re-records components, core, plugin-dashboard and types. `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-unchanged (106 components, sha256 `1f6e1ccb925a…`).

**Pending changesets.** `25831-object-ui-18-1-to-merge.md` and `26276-ui-package-test-vitest.md` each lose their `'@object-ui/sdui-parser'` line, and nothing else changes. Without the edit, `changeset version` fails on a package that is not in the workspace. This is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class of `check-empty-changeset`, so that gate is red until a maintainer confirms the two deletions.

## Verification

Head `7fd87174` on main `62941574`. 185 paths: +1182 / −7242 lines (8424), of which the deleted package and the lockfile account for −7007. Governed: `skills/**` ×1 (`skills/objectui/README.md`, one line) and over the 3000 human-merge line.

- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 137. All 137 ran:
  - 136 exit 0;
  - `check-empty-changeset` exits 1 for the reason above;
  - 119 ran on `90f44cec`. The 18 families added by the `check:lockstep-package-count --fix` commit, plus that gate, ran on `0b13f123`, whose tree equals `7fd87174`. Only the commit message was reworded.
  - `--ran` reconciles 137 derived, 137 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **ui vitest:**
  - On this head: the 83 changed or importing test files, 1663 tests, all pass.
  - On the pre-rebase tree (the same change on PR 1's head), the whole `unit` project ran: 1643 files and 31054 tests. Every red was fixed in this diff, except the 47→48 `ObjectSchema` key pin, which main already carries.
  - Also on the pre-rebase tree: `dom-heavy` passed 35 of 35 files, and `dom` shards 1–3 of 4 passed 2914 files. Shard 4 was cut off by the local time limit, and CI's 16 shards cover it.
- **Push battery** (`GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`) on `7fd87174`: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2164 cases pass`, exit 0.
- **2i overlap:** 2i PR A (#26315) touches the ui filter and the manifest prose, so whichever lands second rebases.

## Changeset

`.changeset/25712-renderer-runs-one-sdui-parser.md`: a `patch` for the 13 published `@object-ui/*` packages whose dependency moved, with the Clause-② narrowing above and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker.
